Messages.Author: Michelle Strinja
Messages.Body:
Primal Instincts
Card reads cancel this vampires strike and choose a new one ?
Who chooses that strike the person playing the card or the owner of the
vamp?

Messages.Author: Noal McDonald
Messages.Body:


Both. It's the same person. Primal Instincts cancels _your_ vampire's
strike and you get to choose a new one. Primal Instincts has no effect
on the strike of an opposing vampire.

Noal McDonald

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Michelle Strinja wrote:
>
> Primal Instincts
> Card reads cancel this vampires strike and choose a new one ?
> Who chooses that strike the person playing the card or the owner of the
> vamp?

The person playing the card *is* the owner (assume you mean "controller")
of the vamp.

The vampire plays Primal Instincts to cancel his own ("this vampire's")
strike and to choose another.
